method: Convex weights on a predeclared 0.1 grid, fitted by training log loss. No raw score/uncertainty predictors are counted again. Each week uses preceding weeks only; compare with an identically fitted football-plus-book control.

audit.contracts: Exact game, teams, kickoff, home spread line and outcome orientation verified
audit.historical_price_kind: Historical price-series sample; sample timestamp does not establish last-trade freshness
audit.moneyline_tie_normalization: Polymarket half-payout normalized using the original forecast tie probability
audit.old_blend_issue: Old fit was anchored to sportsbook log odds and penalized the football correction toward zero; market-dominated output could erase useful football information
audit.evaluation_issue: Earlier Week 1–3 results used the final fit and were in-sample; this revision reports preceding-week fits instead
audit.independent_validation: Week 4 has already been examined; its reuse is exploratory. Only games after this recorded freeze can provide a new prospective test
